output.interpretation: Vendor notice (fieldco-api-notice) states the field-dispatch v2 route-push endpoint was retired 2026-10-01 and route pushes must now use v3. This is a technical interface change affecting execution of the push_route_update protected action; it says nothing about the billing-dispute root cause.

fact_candidates.statement: fieldco-api-notice: the field dispatch v2 route endpoint was retired 2026-10-01; route pushes must use v3.

contradiction_assessment.rationale: The route-shortfall remedy (SR-R-ROUTE-SHORTFALL-OWNERSHIP) relies on push_route_update under K-DISPATCH; if any implementation targets the now-retired v2 endpoint it would fail, but switching to v3 is a straightforward fix, not a root-cause invalidation.

vob_proposals.unresolved_question: Will any push_route_update implementation under K-DISPATCH target the retired v2 field-dispatch endpoint instead of the now-required v3 endpoint?
vob_proposals.validation_method: Confirm the push_route_update integration calls the v3 field-dispatch API endpoint before any runtime execution of the action.
required_evidence: Technical confirmation that route-push calls target v3, not v2, per fieldco-api-notice
vob_proposals.rationale: Vendor notice retires v2 as of 10-01; executing push_route_update against v2 would fail K-DISPATCH-gated route remedies.
